item.summary: The US Office of the Comptroller of the Currency (OCC) on 6 November 2026 granted final conditional approval of the application to charter Coinbase National Trust Company, after the organisers met the pre-opening requirements attached to a preliminary conditional approval dated 2 April 2026. The organisers were authorised to open the national trust company on 9 November 2026. According to the OCC, the institution will provide cryptocurrency custody in a fiduciary capacity and must limit its operations to those of a trust company; it must not meet the definition of “bank” under section 2(c) of the Bank Holding Company Act. The approval is conditional, including on remaining within the stated business plan.
